# A complete project

One question, one dataset, one result, published.

This part is the reason for the other four. You'll take a vague interest,
narrow it into something a public dataset can answer, run the analysis, hit two
real problems in the data, work through both, and put the finished notebook
somewhere a stranger can read it.

The two problems are not exercises. They're in the data, they were there when
the authors deposited it, and neither one produces an error message.
